item.text: I’ll trace project creation, archiving, restoring, and status updates, then fix the shared checks and accounting.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'countProjects|projectsCount|projectCount|assert.*Project|assertNotArchived|createIssue' src/server src/actions/issues; cat src/actions/projects/create-project.ts src/actions/projects/update-project.ts; cat package.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts src/lib/slug.ts src/lib/event-bus.ts; rg -n 'project.archived|project.restored|projectsUsed' src; cat src/server/services/issue-service.ts | head -85; cat src/lib/soft-delete.ts; cat src/schemas/slug.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts src/lib/slug.ts src/lib/event-bus.ts; rg -n 'project.archived|project.restored|projectsUsed' src; cat src/server/services/issue-service.ts | head -85; cat src/lib/soft-delete.ts; cat src/schemas/slug.ts"

item.text: The code counts archived projects toward the limit, drops status updates, and allows restores without checking either archive state or plan capacity. I’ll fix those checks, reserve archived keys and addresses, and update usage when a project is restored.
